Lu4: Raid Bosses

NPC 30.06.2026

Basics

The Lu4 team has made a number of changes to the Raid Boss mechanics. The core concept remains unchanged, but some aspects of gameplay have been reworked:

  • The location of some Raid Bosses has been changed
  • The respawn time of Raid Bosses has been changed
  • The drop of Raid Bosses has been reworked and updated
  • The "flag" mechanic applies when attacking all Raid Bosses

This article provides information about all Raid Bosses on Lu4.

Attention!

On the Boss page, you can view the marker on the World Map and the respawn time of the Raid Boss!

Level 20-24

Zombie Lord Ferkel Raid Boss Lv. 20

HP 87 696 MP 8 254
P. Atk. 129 M. Atk. 6
P. Def. 288 M. Def. 308
Exp 300 000 SP 37 265
Attack Attribute None Defense Attribute Fire 20, Water 20, Wind 53, Earth 20, Holy 20, Unholy 20

This immortal creature was created by Dark Elven dark magic. During the early days of the war between the Elves and Dark Elves, the Dark Elves found themselves on the defensive. Experimenting with the power of Dark Arts they had embraced, they resurrected a number of slain warriors. Once a brave elven knight, Ferkel became of those revived warriors turned into bloodthirsty undead beasts. He slaughtered countless fellow Elves during the war and even now thirsts for the blood of living beings.

An Evil Spirit worshipped like a god by the Langk Lizardmen who live in the south of Gludio. He looks like a snake and has ruled the spiritual world of the lizardmen for hundreds of years. Orfen Epic Boss Lv. 66

HP 22 610 000 MP 3 685
P. Atk. 28 927 M. Atk. 434
P. Def. 1 401 M. Def. 1 626
Exp 15 246 000 SP 1 000 000
Attack Attribute None Defense Attribute Fire 20, Water 20, Wind 53, Earth 20, Holy 20, Unholy 20

One of the three arachnas and the younger sister of Nerupa. She sought to end the war between elves and humans. Caught in the crossfire of a fierce battle, she suffered grievous wounds and retreated deep into the forest, where she fell into a deep slumber to recover. When she awoke centuries later, the once-lush forest had become a desolate, corrupted swamp, and fury consumed her. Her mind, poisoned by the swamp’s toxins, grew unstable. Driven by rage, she began to lash out indiscriminately, attacking both humans and elves in the surrounding lands.

Core Epic Boss Lv. 66

HP 30 642 500 MP 1 277
P. Atk. 544 M. Atk. 1 751
P. Def. 1 471 M. Def. 1 548
Exp 16 552 800 SP 1 000 000
Attack Attribute None Defense Attribute Fire 20, Water 20, Wind 53, Earth 20, Holy 20, Unholy 20

The giants’ supercomputer, known as Core, was constructed during an era when the tower functioned as a fortress-laboratory dedicated to the creation of new life forms. Core controlled all operations within the tower and manipulated the minds of the lower races created there. Following the collapse of the giant civilisation, it lay inactive for centuries until a dwarven researcher named Piliel Aurura accidentally reactivated it by dislodging the control device. Upon reawakening, Core seized control of nearby lower beings, who then initiated to defend the tower against any intruders.
